title: 1835 shop signs are fixed to the building, not hung
items: The 35 signs that hung from brackets or under awnings in 1835 are now boards fixed flat on the shop or tavern front, over the door or beside it.
Each keeps its wording, colours and lettering, and stays clear of doors, windows and shutters.
Tavern posts at the street edge stay: they are the one free-standing sign the period pictures show.
